properties.site-address: Old Pumping Station, 133 Rusper Road, Horsham (North Horsham)
properties.notes: This site is located in the built-up area of Horsham and is accessed from Rusper Road. Planning permission for 24 flats was granted in 2002 for 24 flats, (NH/157/02) but was not implemented. This permission expired in 2010, but the landowner has indicated that they would like the site to remain in the SHLAA, indicating that the land is available for residential development. The site area of this land extends beyond the original planning permission to include additional units. This extended area increases the potential of the site to 30 dwellings. Given that the permission was not implemented, further work may be required to bring this site forward and the site is considered available and suitable for development 6-10 years. A scheme of this size would likely be delivered in a single phase
